policy: First existing development fold,10/16/20 candidate pools. Each raw grid contains18 p2 points from a fixed seeded-random basis plus frozen analytic random/MI p2 points and two unentangled basis controls. Calibrate every distinct physical readout map. All PUBs512 shots. Choose only candidate circuits by unconditional full penalized training-QUBO expected energy, then index for ties, after validating at least one feasible observed subset. Controls cannot masquerade as quantum winners. Freeze chosen parameters and subsets before separate raw/DD confirmation. No outer validation, predictor error or final years may select the hardware point.
budget_policy: Actual live monthly guard before preparation and every submission; total personal worst-case210 seconds, PINQ50 separately. Total new project reserve260 below tentative280. No retries/replacements of failed or ambiguous intents. Small jobs, uniform shots, fully private identifiers. Future-stage plans must be separately frozen before each acquisition and release unused reserve when pruned.
preflight_policy: Small full-circuit parity, exact cardinality/global-phase tests, then actual native compilation for basis versus original Dicke. Remove first global cost phase on a basis state; same full objective scored after measurement. Changes in initialization/support and compilation/layout/time block any intrinsic hardware or speedup claim.
